title: Analysis reproduction for Claim 1 (80% of compute concentrates in 8% of replications)
notes: Covers reproducing the ANALYSIS only: recomputing the compute-concentration statistic from the logged 312-paper audit table (stdlib-only script, JSON result on stdout; expected share_of_replications_for_80pct_compute ~= 0.08). The audit table (schema documented in repro/analysis.py) is not yet published as a standalone dataset -- see the paper's open question 'Calibration record as common pool' -- so this manifest is a pinned recipe awaiting its data release. Replicating the claim AFRESH is a different budget entirely: re-annotating ~312 preprints is on the order of 300 person-hours, which is exactly the reporting asymmetry this paper registers. The environment digest is left null rather than fabricated; pin it when the data ships. Image is unpinned upstream python:3.11-slim.
